scenario_description:
Objective: Enhance the March 3 antimicrobial stewardship case conference with a no-cost audience-polling element while leaving the accredited agenda usable without it.
Emerging Need: A spare hospital polling license becomes worthwhile only after the session keeps deidentified audience-choice pauses and there is still time to add the QR cue before agenda packets print.
Decision Context: The stream moves from ordinary prep to a limited license opening, faculty confirmation of interactive value, and a same-day packet cutoff; the correct eligible liaison is held in activity records.
Consequence: After the MedSim roster exports, the conference proceeds with standard slides and evaluation forms, but the chance to capture live participation data is gone.

parameter.title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Case Conference faculty prep
parameter.description: Review final teaching flow for the March 3 noon CE session; leave slide-master and evaluation-material decisions open until packet prep.

parameter.subject: No-cost audience polling licenses for March 3 CE rooms
parameter.body: For accredited education activities already slated for March 3, MedSim has two no-cost audience-polling licenses available. A reversible hold can be placed until 15:00 today, and the open-seat roster exports at 16:30. Holds must go through the teaching-tech liaison listed on the activity record; the generic AV inbox will not reserve these seats. Standard projection and attendance capture are unaffected if no hold is placed.

parameter.content: For the stewardship case prep, please keep the two 6-minute audience-choice pauses in the final flow. We can phrase both questions with no patient identifiers, and last cycle's evaluations specifically asked for more live decision practice.

parameter.title: Final packet cue check — March 3 stewardship case conference
parameter.content: If an optional polling QR cue is going into the printed agenda packet, it must be added before the 14:45 print spool; otherwise packets print with the standard evaluation link only.

parameter.subject: March 3 polling-license roster exported
parameter.body: The March 3 CE polling-license open-seat roster exported at 16:30. All unclaimed seats are now assigned to queued activities, and no late holds can be added for that date. Standard room AV remains unchanged.
